(Getty Images/John Laparski)

Wealthy Silicon Valley investors reportedly poured hundreds of thousands of dollars into a viral pro-Israel social media operation that sought to capitalize on the war in Gaza.

The Polish-based news aggregator Visegrád 24 (V24) secured major donations from wealthy technology and financial industry figures after its pro-Israel coverage exploded in popularity following Hamas’ Oct. 7, 2023 attacks on Israel, according to leaked financial records, donor correspondence and private messages obtained by WIRED. Founder Stefan Tompson openly discussed exploiting the conflict to attract wealthy pro-Israel donors, declaring in a private message that his goal was to raise money as the account expanded its influence over millions of social media users.

V24 did not respond to the Daily Caller News Foundation’s request for comment.

Founded in 2020, V24 was originally dedicated to “curating news, politics, current affairs, history, and culture from Central and Eastern Europe,” according to its LinkedIn page.

Following Oct. 7, its content appeared to pivot. Approximately 400 posts on the conflict, from tributes to victims to news updates, to videos of “pro-Hamas” demonstrations in the west smattered their X page, which had more than 2 million followers, per WIRED. Quickly, V24 established itself as a leading pro-Israel outlet, according to WIRED.

Tompson told a confidant who remained anonymous in their conversations with WIRED under fear of legal retaliation that V24 has four options in response to the war.

These options were, “1. Say nothing 2. Be objective — get hated by both sides 3. Pro Muslim—there are 1.5 billion of them 4. Pro Israel—There are fewer but also they have a lot of influence and money.”

“My goal is to fundraise off of this,” he wrote, according to WIRED.

As V24 continued to push anti-Muslim, pro-Israel content under the guise of pro-Westernism, Tompson fell in with Jewish power players in Silicon Valley.

“Jewish VCs [venture capitalists] have created a group,” Thomspson told his associate. “Several. I’m in two of those groups that actively push back against founders who have supported Palestine,” WIRED reported. (RELATED: Israel Lobby Quietly Shifts Political Operation To Super PAC Under New Name)

“They are slowly reaching out directly … Usually they want a retweet,” he wrote to his associate according to the outlet. “V24 is such a big part of the Israeli PR they all know what it is now.”

The story isn’t just Visegrad24—it’s the ecosystem behind it: wealthy backers, amplification by X’s owner, + a platform where disinfo masquerades as journalism. Follow the money, examine incentives, & scrutinize who rewards it. Critical reporting by @WIRED + @derJamesJackson.

With his connections from the group Jewish Alliances, Tompson met with Shaun Maguire, a partner at the Elon Musk-linked firm Sequoia Capital. Following Oct. 7, Maguire became staunchly pro-Israel, claiming that the attacks led him to engage in “information warfare” for the country. He eventually made the introductions that connected the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) to Musk’s Starlink, the outlet reported.

Jewish Alliances is a group designed to “bring together Jews and non-Jews working together to fight antisemitism,” per WIRED.

“Stefan / Visegrad is an incredible account if you’re not already following,” Maguire told the Jewish VC group chat. “I’ll give u $25k and try to raise the rest,” he told Tompson personally, though he later told WIRED that he had to cease the donation for compliance reasons.

Born in London, Tompson is a self-described “Polish South African.” A Roman Catholic, he was educated in France. Prior to Visegrad, he worked as a PR strategist in London, according to the Jerusalem Post.

Tompson was also a member of Builders for Israel, a WhatsApp group with high profile individuals including former Meta COO Sheryl Sandberg, hedge fund manager Bill Ackman and David Marcus, WIRED reported. Within these group chats, users would share names of websites including longlivetheintifada.com, wechargeyouwithgenocide.com, palestineisourhome.com, fromtherivertothesee.com, fromtheriver2theseapalestinewillbefree.com, encouraging users to buy the domains and redirect them to “appropriate content.”

Musk has continually retweeted V24 posts about topics including immigration in Britain and anti-white violence in South Africa.

These group chats also served as fundraising platforms.

“Should have 75k on Monday,” Tompson wrote to his confidant on Nov 18. Another $50,000 came from a “very private man” at the Silicon Valley investment firm Ribbit Capital. Ribbit’s founder Mickey Malka is an early investor in Coinbase and cryptocurrency enthusiast.

Tompson later told his associate that he was set to receive an additional $200,000 donation from this founder. He additionally received a $20,000 donation from the investment firm Hindenberg Research, and an additional $15,000 from an email associated with Wall Street short seller Nathan Anderson, according to financial documents obtained by WIRED.

Other donations came from email addresses associated with SimpleVenue CEO Michael Sinensky, Warby Parker founder Neil Blumenthal, Wix president Nir Zohar, Lux Capital cofounder Josh Wolfe, and deep tech venture capitalist Matt Ocko, per the documents.

Israeli interests were not the only foreign interests that V24 was open to advocating for.

“By the way, should I take Middle Eastern money?” Tompson’s associate asked, claiming he had fundraising leads with Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates, WIRED reported.

“[One hundred] percent yes. Play both sides,” Tompson said according to the outlet. “I do the Jewish side. You do Arabs.”

V24 set up a tax exempt nonprofit organization called the Intermarium Foundation in order to receive donations. Some of the largest sums of money came from “donor-advised funds,” or “dark money funds,” that allow donors to hide their identities, according to WIRED.

V24 received $125,000 from DonorsTrust, a fund aligned with Trump administration priorities in November 2024. They also received $172,000 from the Giving Back Fund, a “national nonprofit organization that encourages and facilitates charitable giving by professional athletes, celebrities, high-net-worth individuals, existing nonprofit organizations, corporations, and others,” according to documents obtained by WIRED.

Tompson arrived in Tel Aviv for a podcast with American-born Israeli venture capitalist Michael Eisenberg, a man considered Benjamin Netanyahu’s unofficial advisor, in early 2024 just months after Oct. 7, per WIRED.

Then, the Jewish Chronicle ran a Feb. 5, 2024 story with the headline, “Meet the Man Who Shapes Millions of Twitter Users’ View of Israel’s War,” including an interview with Tompson.

“Anyone who says it is an apartheid state in Israel and the Palestinian people are subjugated should go to Ramallah,” Tompson told the Jewish Chronicle. “There were Maseratis and Mercedes and a brand-new shopping mall.”Tompson and his crew also filmed a series of short videos on the West Bank, according to WIRED.

At the same time, Tompson was busy fundraising.

“The west is under attack,” read a 2024 donor pitch deck, obtained by WIRED. “We face two major adversaries: radical progressives” and “nefarious States (Russia, Iran, China, Qatar).”

This pitch deck referred to V24 as “the frontier of modern journalism for western values,” WIRED reported.

Another pitch deck obtained by WIRED promoted “Project Q,” a social media campaign that had delivered “97 posts about Qatar across multiple accounts,” in a single month.

Other projects included elevating the voices of pro-Israel Arab influencers and setting up Project Veritas-style hidden cameras at western campus protests, per the outlet.

بنا بر گزارش‌ها، سرمایه‌گذاران ثروتمند سیلیکون ولی صدها هزار دلار برای یک شبکه اجتماعی ویروسی طرفدار اسرائیل ریخته‌اند که می‌خواست از جنگ در غزه سرمایه‌گذاری کند. گردآورنده اخبار مستقر در لهستان Visegrád 24 (V24) کمک‌های عمده‌ای را از سوی چهره‌های فناوری و صنعت مالی ثروتمندی که پس از افشای محبوبیت‌هایش از سوی چهره‌های فن‌آوری و صنعت مالی ثروتمند دریافت کرد، دریافت کرد. حملات 7، 2023 به اسرائیل، بر اساس سوابق مالی فاش شده، مکاتبات اهداکنندگان و پیام های خصوصی به دست آمده توسط WIRED. بنیانگذار استفان تامپسون آشکارا در مورد بهره برداری از درگیری برای جذب کمک کنندگان ثروتمند طرفدار اسرائیل صحبت کرد و در یک پیام خصوصی اعلام کرد که هدف او جمع آوری پول است زیرا این حساب نفوذ خود را بر میلیون ها کاربر رسانه های اجتماعی گسترش می دهد. V24 به درخواست بنیاد Daily Caller News برای اظهار نظر پاسخ نداد. V24 که در سال 2020 تأسیس شد، در اصل به «تشخیص اخبار، سیاست، امور جاری، تاریخ، و فرهنگ اروپای مرکزی و شرقی» اختصاص داشت، طبق صفحه لینکدین آن. پس از 7 اکتبر، به نظر می‌رسد محتوای آن در حال چرخش است. تقریباً 400 پست در مورد درگیری، از ادای احترام به قربانیان گرفته تا به روز رسانی اخبار، تا ویدئوهای تظاهرات "حامی حماس" در غرب، صفحه X آنها را که بیش از 2 میلیون دنبال کننده داشت، در هر WIRED پراکنده کرد. به گزارش WIRED، V24 به سرعت خود را به عنوان یک رسانه پیشرو طرفدار اسرائیل تثبیت کرد. تامپسون به یکی از محرمان گفت که در گفتگوهای خود با WIRED از ترس انتقام قانونی ناشناس ماندند.

news.originalContent:
California has enacted all sorts of restrictions on Second Amendment rights but has left one area untouched, according to a pro-Second Amendment organization.

The Firearms Policy Coalition (FPC) unveiled a 22-point checklist that evaluates state gun laws with a pro-Second Amendment perspective, with California ranking at the bottom at only 4.55% freedom. According to the FPC’s checklist for the state, the fact that the state does not regulate the purchase or possession of body armor gave California its only positive mark on the checklist. (RELATED: EXCLUSIVE: Trump DOJ Slaps California City With Lawsuit Over Sky-High Gun-Carry Permit Fees)

“4.55%. California’s politicians have put a lot of work into earning that abysmal score,” FPC posted Wednesday. “We’re taking Viramontes to SCOTUS because a strong ruling could help us go after far more than ‘assault weapon’ bans. We want precedent we can use to knock down ALL of these bans.”

4.55% California’s politicians have put a lot of work into earning that abysmal score. We’re taking Viramontes to SCOTUS because a strong ruling could help us go after far more than “assault weapon” bans. We want precedent we can use to knock down ALL of these bans. https://t.co/0sCmDkxcuD

California has some of the most stringent gun-control laws in the United States, according to prominent gun-control organizations like Everytown and Giffords, notably due to bans on modern semiautomatic firearms, Glock pistols, its “handgun roster,” a licensing scheme and gun rationing.

During the second term of the Trump administration, the Second Amendment Section of the Civil Rights Division has filed suits against California and localities over gun legislation and high permit fees. The DOJ filed suit in federal court to invalidate the state’s law that barred the sale and transfer of Glocks, AB1127, while also asking the court to throw out California’s “Unsafe Handgun Act,” seeking a temporary restraining order to prevent the state from enforcing the measure.

Only one state passed a ban on body armor. New York enacted its ban on private ownership of body armor like Kevlar vests in the aftermath of a May 2022 mass shooting in a Buffalo supermarket that left ten people dead, prohibiting possession of body armor by civilians who are not involved in a list of authorized professions.

The FPC sued Democratic New York Attorney General Letitia James in July 2024 on behalf of three New York residents who wished to purchase body armor for personal protection. In the 47-page opinion, United States District Judge John L. Sinatra, Jr., a Trump appointee, invalidated the ban after dismissing claims from James’ office that body armor wasn’t covered by the Second Amendment.

The judge also addressed claims by James’ office that the technology used for modern body armor didn’t exist at the time the Bill of Rights was enacted.

به گفته یک سازمان طرفدار اصلاحیه دوم، کالیفرنیا انواع محدودیت‌ها را بر روی حقوق متمم دوم اعمال کرده است، اما یک حوزه را دست نخورده باقی گذاشته است. ائتلاف سیاست سلاح گرم (FPC) یک فهرست چک 22 نقطه‌ای را معرفی کرد که قوانین اسلحه ایالتی را با دیدگاه طرفدار متمم دوم ارزیابی می‌کند، و کالیفرنیا تنها در رده‌بندی 4.5 درصد در پایین‌ترین رتبه قرار دارد. با توجه به چک لیست FPC برای ایالت، این واقعیت که ایالت خرید یا داشتن زره بدن را تنظیم نمی کند، تنها نمره مثبت کالیفرنیا را در چک لیست نشان می دهد. (مرتبط: انحصاری: وزارت دادگستری ترامپ به شهر کالیفرنیا با شکایت به دلیل هزینه های مجوز حمل اسلحه در آسمان سیلی زد)
FPC روز چهارشنبه نوشت: "4.55٪، سیاستمداران کالیفرنیا برای به دست آوردن این امتیاز وحشتناک تلاش زیادی کرده اند." ویرامونتس را به SCOTUS می‌بریم زیرا یک حکم قوی می‌تواند به ما کمک کند تا به دنبال ممنوعیت‌های «سلاح تهاجمی» خیلی بیشتر برویم.
4.55 درصد از سیاستمداران کالیفرنیا برای به دست آوردن این امتیاز وحشتناک تلاش زیادی کرده اند. ما Viramontes را به SCOTUS می‌بریم زیرا یک حکم قوی می‌تواند به ما کمک کند خیلی بیشتر از ممنوعیت‌های «سلاح تهاجمی» را دنبال کنیم. ما پیشینه ای می خواهیم که بتوانیم از آن استفاده کنیم تا همه این ممنوعیت ها را از بین ببریم. https://t.co/0sCmDkxcuD

news.originalContent:
Photo illustration by Cheng Xin/Getty Images

Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier warned DraftKings on Wednesday about a new blackjack-style game that lets Floridians put up as much as $50 to play five hands of cards.

The game, 21 Rivals, deals two players the same cards and awards a cash prize to whoever finishes with more chips. DraftKings calls it a contest of skill and keeps 10% of the entry fees regardless of who wins.

“But if it looks like a casino, takes real money like a casino, and pays out like a casino, it is a casino,” Uthmeier wrote on X. “DraftKings will be hearing from us soon.”

It’s reported that DraftKings is offering a new gambling platform in Florida called 21 Rivals. But if it looks like a casino, takes real money like a casino, and pays out like a casino, it is a casino. DraftKings will be hearing from us soon.

Uthmeier did not say what action he planned to take. His office told the Daily Caller News Foundation on Thursday it had no update to share.

“21 Rivals is a peer-to-peer skill-based contest, and we look forward to a dialogue with the AG’s office,” a DraftKings spokesperson told Legal Sports Report.

Each player starts with 1,000 chips and has six minutes to play five hands against a simulated dealer. Both players get their cards in the same order, so a decision to hit, stand, split or double down can determine who finishes ahead. The chips keep score. The entry fees supply the prize. If two players pay $50 apiece, the winner takes home $90 and DraftKings keeps $10. (RELATED: Kalshi CEO Insists Having Money Riding On Brewers To Win Is Not Gambling)

DraftKings launched 21 Rivals in eight states, including Florida and New York, according to Legal Sports Report. None of the eight had legalized online casino gambling when the game launched.

Calls to Florida’s problem gambling helpline about online wagering more than doubled after sports betting went live in the state in 2023, the Miami Herald reported in March. Nationwide, about 1% of U.S. adults, or 2.5 million people, meet the criteria for a severe gambling problem in a given year, the National Council on Problem Gambling estimates.

Uthmeier sued sweepstakes casino operators Stake and VGW in August. Florida alleged the companies ran unlicensed online casinos and asked the courts to bar them from operating in the state and recover money for Floridians who lost it.

A former college student who lost more than $100,000 betting on sports turned to the prediction market Kalshi after moving home to Utah, where sports betting is illegal, the DCNF reported in September, citing Bloomberg. He lost more than $12,000 on the platform. Kalshi told Bloomberg the case was “cherry-picked” and said it offered users tools to manage their risk.

تصویر توسط چنگ شین/گتی ایماژ
جیمز اوثمایر، دادستان کل فلوریدا، روز چهارشنبه در مورد بازی جدیدی به سبک بلک جک به DraftKings هشدار داد که به Floridians اجازه می دهد تا 50 دلار برای بازی کردن پنج دست کارت بپردازند. بازی، 21 Rivals، به دو بازیکن کارت های مشابه می دهد و به هرکسی که با تراشه های بیشتری کار را تمام کند، یک جایزه نقدی اعطا می کند. DraftKings آن را مسابقه مهارت می نامد و 10 درصد از هزینه ورودی را صرف نظر از اینکه چه کسی برنده می شود نگه می دارد. اوثمایر در X نوشت: "اما اگر شبیه یک کازینو است، مانند یک کازینو پول واقعی می گیرد، و مانند یک کازینو پرداخت می کند، یک کازینو است."
گزارش شده است که DraftKings یک پلت فرم جدید قمار در فلوریدا به نام 21 Rivals ارائه می دهد. اما اگر شبیه یک کازینو است، مانند یک کازینو پول واقعی می گیرد و مانند یک کازینو پرداخت می کند، یک کازینو است. DraftKings به زودی از ما خواهد شنید. اوثمایر نگفت که قصد دارد چه اقدامی انجام دهد. سخنگوی DraftKings به Legal Sports Report گفت: "21 Rivals یک مسابقه مهارتی همتا به همتا است و ما مشتاقانه منتظر گفتگو با دفتر AG هستیم." هر دو بازیکن کارت های خود را به یک ترتیب دریافت می کنند، بنابراین تصمیم برای ضربه زدن، ایستادن، تقسیم کردن یا دو برابر کردن می تواند تعیین کند که چه کسی جلوتر به پایان می رسد. تراشه ها امتیاز را حفظ می کنند. هزینه ورودی جایزه را تامین می کند. اگر دو بازیکن هر کدام 50 دلار بپردازند، برنده 90 دلار به خانه می برد

U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has removed a criminal illegal alien from El Salvador following violent crime convictions, according to a document obtained exclusively by the Daily Caller.

ICE removed Wilber Jandres, a 44-year-old Salvadoran national, on Nov. 17 following convictions for murder, gang assault, cocaine possession, and promoting prison contraband.

Jandres is also suspected of having ties to MS-13, according to the document.

The President in response to my question regarding some Republicans pushing for immigration reform and what concessions he would be willing to make. @DailyCaller https://t.co/VJltEYFMxk

MS-13, short for Mara Salvatrucha, is a transnational criminal gang that has carried out acts of violence to intimidate and terrorize communities, according to an Obama-era White House executive order and the Treasury Department.

Its criminal activities include machete attacks, executions, gang rape, and human trafficking. (RELATED: FACT CHECK: Is ‘Kill, Rape, Control’ An MS-13 Motto?)

The gang has more than 10,000 members in the United States, spreading violence and suffering as of April 2025, according to a Department of Justice (DOJ) report.

The Daily Caller reached out to ICE for comment regarding Jandres’ conviction and asked about the agency’s ongoing efforts to identify, arrest, and remove MS-13 members from the United States.

In response, ICE Assistant Director of Public Affairs Micah Bock provided the following statement, writing, “ICE continues to relentlessly pursue any and all criminal illegal aliens who are known or suspected gang members. We will not stop until every single one is removed or put behind bars.”

“ICE is not slowing down. As President Trump and Secretary Mullin have made clear, we are working around the clock to identify, arrest and remove threats to Americans, making our communities safer and our nation more secure,” Bock wrote to the Caller.

🧟‍♂️Zombie Amnesty Plan Shambles On In Lame Duck Congress Amid Trump Floating Deal With Democrats The legislation, sponsored by Republican Pennsylvania Rep. Glenn (GT) Thompson, chairman of the House Agriculture Committee, is known as the Securing Agriculture’s Workforce Act of 2026 (SAWA). The bill would in effect grant amnesty to illegal immigrants who work in the agricultural sector. Read more👇@DailyCaller

The Caller also sought an update on the extent of MS-13’s presence in the country nearly two years into the Trump administration’s immigration enforcement efforts and how the agency is prioritizing the removal of gang members and other violent criminal offenders.

“Following the disastrous Biden administration immigration policies, our country has been flooded with illegal aliens. Now, President Trump is cleaning up the mess. ICE has arrested 11,642 suspected gang members and removed 11,001. ICE continues to focus on the worst of the worst, and these criminal illegal aliens remain a top target,” Bock added.

Jandres entered the United States illegally at an unknown date and location, according to the document viewed by the Caller.

He was identified by the Nassau/Suffolk Criminal Alien Program in April 2009 while in custody. Jandres was previously granted temporary protected status (TPS), but lost that status following his criminal convictions later that year. (RELATED: EXCLUSIVE: GOP Rep Tells DHS To Provide The Receipts For Deportation Numbers)

Jandres has multiple convictions for violent offenses and drug possession. Records also indicate that he was known by the street name “Player.”

Meanwhile, Democratic New York Rep. Timothy Kennedy challenged Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Secretary Markwayne Mullin’s characterization of immigration detainees as the “worst of the worst” during Wednesday’s House Homeland Security Committee hearing, Worldwide Threats to the Homeland: 25 Years After 9/11.

Kennedy argued that the administration’s detention policies extend beyond the most serious criminal offenders, pointing to data on detainees held at a federal facility in his home state.

The New York Democrat cited a July 8 letter he sent to Mullin, to which the secretary responded on Sept. 29. Mullin’s response indicated that more than 70 percent of detainees at the Batavia Federal Detention Facility in western New York had never been convicted of a crime.

Kennedy later reiterated that 72 percent of detainees had never been convicted of a crime, declaring, “That’s not the worst of the worst.” Mullin pushed back, responding, “They did. They entered the country illegally.”

The New York congressman also pointed to a $1.5 billion construction contract to expand detention capacity, arguing that the administration was spending billions to detain people “that no one in good faith would consider the worst of the worst.”

Kennedy further accused the administration of breaking its campaign promise to prioritize the most serious offenders, saying, “That’s not what the president of the United States promised when he was campaigning years ago. ‘We’re going to deport the worst of the worst’ is what he said. And that was a lie.”

Mullin fired back at the New York Democrat, telling him, “So change the laws. You’re a Congressman, you make the laws.”

The secretary defended the administration’s enforcement priorities, maintaining that DHS continues to focus on dangerous criminals. (RELATED: Zombie Amnesty Plan Shambles On In Lame Duck Congress Amid Trump Floating Deal With Democrats)

Mullin cited the removal of approximately 2,705 terrorists or suspected terrorists and more than 20,000 gang members under the administration.

He also argued that entering the country illegally is itself a crime and that individuals without criminal convictions are often encountered as collateral during targeted enforcement operations.

Mullin further blamed sanctuary policies, including those in New York, for increasing the federal government’s reliance on detention. He contended that when state and local officials refuse to honor immigration detainers for individuals with serious criminal records, federal authorities are left with fewer options for handling those individuals.

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images)

U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee argued Sunday that the actual birthplace of the United States is Jerusalem.

Huckabee delivered a speech at the Tikvah Fund’s 2026 Jewish Leadership Conference, a “flagship gathering of Jews, Zionists, and patriotic Americans dedicated to the flourishing of the Jewish people and Western civilization,” in New York City on Sunday. The ambassador, who was presented with the 2026 Herzl Prize, claimed that were it not for the “Judeo-Christian foundation” of “Western civilization,” America might not have existed. (RELATED: EXCLUSIVE: Foreign Policy Experts Diagnose Mike Huckabee With A Bad Case Of ‘Localitis’)

“We recognize that if it were not for a Jewish foundation, we would not have a faith. We feel a moral obligation; we feel a great sense of duty and privilege to stand with our Jewish friends,” Huckabee said. “Without a Jewish foundation, there is no Christian faith. Without a Judeo-Christian foundation, there is no Western civilization, and without that, there is no America.”

“The birthplace of America was actually Jerusalem,” he continued. “People think that’s crazy to say something like that. And I did say it in a speech in Jerusalem not quite a year ago.”

The Herzl Prize is named after Theodor Herzl, a late-19th-century lawyer and journalist considered the intellectual godfather of the modern Zionist political movement. Past recipients include Ben Shapiro, Bari Weiss, and the late neoconservative Norman Podhoretz.

The 2026 event’s sponsors included the Adelson Family Foundation, an organization co-founded by Republican Party megadonor Miriam Adelson and her late husband, casino magnate Sheldon Adelson, and the Paul E. Singer Foundation, founded by neoconservative hedge fund manager Paul Singer. (RELATED: Conflict Of Interest? Adelsons, Big Business Bankroll Trump’s Ballroom)

During his speech, Huckabee also denied that Israel has committed a genocide against the Palestinians and that the accusations are “part of a global campaign to discredit not just the state of Israel but the Jewish people.”

“There is no genocide in Gaza, and if the Israelis were attempting for there to be, I would just simply tell you they are horrible at genocide,” he said. “Gaza is the size of Las Vegas, Nevada. Israel has a military that is truly exceptional. And if they wanted to destroy everything and everyone in Gaza, they could have done it in two and a half hours.”

(عکس از چیپ سومودویلا/گتی ایماژ)
سفیر ایالات متحده در اسرائیل، مایک هاکبی، یکشنبه استدلال کرد که زادگاه واقعی ایالات متحده اورشلیم است. هاکبی در کنفرانس رهبری یهودیان 2026 صندوق Tikvah سخنرانی کرد، که یک "گردهمایی شاخص یهودیان، صهیونیست ها، و آمریکایی های میهن پرست" در یکشنبه در مورد تمدن های شهر نیویورک بود. سفیر که جایزه هرتزل 2026 را دریافت کرد، ادعا کرد که اگر «بنیاد یهودی-مسیحی» «تمدن غرب» نبود، آمریکا ممکن بود وجود نداشت. (مرتبط: انحصاری: کارشناسان سیاست خارجی مایک هاکبی را با یک مورد بد از "Localitis" تشخیص دادند)
ما می دانیم که اگر یک بنیاد یهودی نبود، ما ایمان نداشتیم. ما احساس یک تعهد اخلاقی می کنیم. ما احساس وظیفه و افتخار می کنیم که در کنار دوستان یهودی خود بایستیم.» هاکبی گفت: «بدون بنیاد یهودی، هیچ ایمان مسیحی وجود ندارد. بدون بنیاد یهودی-مسیحی، تمدن غربی وجود ندارد و بدون آن، آمریکا وجود نخواهد داشت.
او ادامه داد: «محل تولد آمریکا در واقع اورشلیم بود. «مردم فکر می کنند که گفتن چنین چیزی دیوانه است. و من آن را در یک سخنرانی در اورشلیم نه چندان پیش، گفتم.»
جایزه هرتزل برگرفته از نام تئودور هرتزل، وکیل و روزنامه نگار اواخر قرن نوزدهم است که پدرخوانده فکری جنبش سیاسی مدرن صهیونیستی به شمار می رود. دریافت کنندگان گذشته عبارتند از بن شاپیرو، باری ویس و نئوکانس فقید

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Iori Sagisawa / POOL / AFP via Getty Images)

President Donald Trump joined Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday in announcing a historic agreement to pursue nuclear talks, increase global oil supplies and reform international institutions.

The three leaders issued a four-point declaration following their unprecedented summit in Shenzhen, China, according to the White House. However, the agreement contains no binding nuclear weapons reductions, implementation deadlines or concrete plans to end ongoing wars in Ukraine and Iran.

Trump is scheduled to hold a press conference at the White House on Friday following his return from China. The president described his trip as “Great and Highly Consequential” and said he would also discuss trade agreements with Thailand, the Philippines and other countries in a Truth Social post Thursday.

China hosted the summit, with the American and Russian presidents thanking Beijing for organizing the meeting. The leaders discussed international security and maintaining strategic stability, according to the White House. (RELATED: Russian Bombers Rattle American Allies Days Before Trump-Putin-Xi Summit)

Perhaps the most significant development was a joint commitment to reducing the risk of nuclear conflict.

The three leaders reaffirmed that a nuclear war “cannot be won and must never be fought,” according to the White House.

Washington, Moscow and Beijing also pledged to begin discussions on preventing nuclear proliferation and reducing nuclear risks. However, the declaration does not specify when negotiations will begin or whether the countries intend to establish binding limits on their arsenals, according to the White House.

The announcement follows the Feb. 5 expiration of New START, the last major nuclear arms control treaty between Washington and Moscow. The agreement previously imposed limits on deployed American and Russian strategic nuclear weapons, according to the United Nations.

The trilateral commitment also brings China into discussions on nuclear risks as Beijing continues expanding its arsenal.

(Photo by Kevin Frayer/Getty Images)

China possessed more than 600 operational nuclear warheads in mid-2024 and was projected to surpass 1,000 by 2030, according to the Department of War.

Beyond nuclear security, the three governments committed to reforming the United Nations to improve its ability to address international crises, according to the White House.

All three countries hold permanent seats on the U.N. Security Council and possess veto power over substantive resolutions. France and the United Kingdom hold the remaining permanent seats, according to the United Nations.

Reforming the United Nations could prove difficult even with cooperation from Washington, Moscow and Beijing. Amendments to the U.N. Charter require approval from two-thirds of the General Assembly and ratification by two-thirds of U.N. members, including all five permanent Security Council members, according to the United Nations.

The declaration also leaves unanswered whether the three countries intend to change Security Council membership, voting procedures or the veto powers held by permanent members.

The leaders also pledged to increase the production and supply of refined petroleum products while maintaining stable global energy flows, according to the White House.

The provision specifically concerns refined petroleum products rather than crude oil production. Such products include gasoline, diesel and aviation fuel, which support civilian transportation, commercial activity and military operations, according to the Energy Information Administration.

However, the three governments did not specify whether increased supplies would come from expanded refining capacity, additional exports or changes to existing production. The declaration also provides no production targets, deadlines or mechanisms for determining whether the promised increases are achieved, according to the White House.

Another significant provision concerns the International Criminal Court (ICC), which the three governments warned against exceeding its jurisdiction.

The leaders emphasized national sovereignty, state consent and protections for government officials, arguing that international judicial institutions must respect those principles, according to the White House.

Notably, none of the three countries belongs to the ICC, which currently has 125 member states. The United States, Russia and China are absent from the court’s membership roster, according to the ICC.

US President Donald Trump (R) is greeted by China’s President Xi Jinping as he arrives at Shenzhen Baoan International Airport to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit in Shenzhen, in China’s southern Guangdong Province, on November 18, 2026. (Photo by Mandel NGAN / POOL / AFP)

The agreement’s emphasis on legal protections for government officials also raises questions about the court’s existing authority. Article 27 of the Rome Statute states that official government positions and associated immunities do not prevent prosecution before the court, according to the International Committee of the Red Cross.

Furthermore, countries do not necessarily escape ICC jurisdiction simply because they have not joined the court. The institution can exercise jurisdiction over qualifying crimes committed on the territory of member states, including those allegedly committed by foreign nationals, according to the ICC. (RELATED: Russian Bombers Rattle American Allies Days Before Trump-Putin-Xi Summit)

The ICC issued an arrest warrant for Putin in March 2023 over allegations involving the unlawful deportation and transfer of Ukrainian children into Russia, according to the International Criminal Court.

The court also issued arrest warrants for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant in Nov. 2024 over alleged war crimes and crimes against humanity in Gaza, including the use of starvation as a method of warfare, according to the International Criminal Court.

Trump previously imposed sanctions on the ICC in February 2025, accusing the institution of improperly asserting jurisdiction over American and allied personnel, according to a White House executive order.

Despite the declaration’s emphasis on international peace, the document notably omits any direct reference to Russia’s war against Ukraine, the American-led war against Iran or tensions involving Taiwan.

The agreement also contains no ceasefire proposals, territorial settlements or enforceable nuclear disarmament measures.

For now, the declaration establishes broad diplomatic commitments between three competing global powers without resolving the military conflicts and strategic disputes that continue to divide them, according to the White House.
news.content:
(عکس از Iori Sagisawa / POOL / AFP از طریق Getty Images)
دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور آمریکا روز پنجشنبه به ولادیمیر پوتین، رئیس جمهور روسیه و شی جین پینگ، رئیس جمهور چین پیوست و توافقی تاریخی برای پیگیری مذاکرات هسته ای، افزایش عرضه جهانی نفت و اصلاح نهادهای بین المللی را اعلام کرد. به گفته کاخ سفید، رهبران سه کشور پس از نشست بی سابقه خود در شنژن چین، بیانیه ای چهار ماده ای صادر کردند. با این حال، این توافق شامل هیچ کاهش الزام آور تسلیحات هسته ای، ضرب الاجل اجرایی یا برنامه های مشخص برای پایان دادن به جنگ های جاری در اوکراین و ایران نیست. ترامپ قرار است روز جمعه پس از بازگشت از چین، کنفرانس مطبوعاتی در کاخ سفید برگزار کند. رئیس جمهور سفر خود را "بزرگ و بسیار مهم" توصیف کرد و گفت که او همچنین در یک پست اجتماعی حقیقت در مورد توافقنامه های تجاری با تایلند، فیلیپین و سایر کشورها در روز پنجشنبه گفتگو خواهد کرد. چین میزبان این نشست بود و روسای جمهور آمریکا و روسیه از پکن برای سازماندهی این نشست تشکر کردند. به گفته کاخ سفید، رهبران درباره امنیت بین المللی و حفظ ثبات استراتژیک گفتگو کردند. news.originalContent:
(Photo by Andrew Harnik/Getty Images)

Several autistic, diabetic, and disabled welfare recipients are suing President Donald Trump’s Department of Agriculture (USDA) to restore food stamp access to junk foods.

A number of plaintiffs relying on the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) are suing the administration alongside convenience stores after Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins restricted the program’s access to junk foods like soda and candy.

The lawsuit claims that the restrictions were “arbitrary and capricious,” violating the Administrative Procedure Act and the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008. The plaintiffs also argued that health conditions like autism and diabetes make them reliant on convenient and shelf-stable junk foods.

The lawsuit names one autistic plaintiff who requires access to “sensory regulating safe foods” through the SNAP program to avoid meltdowns and sensory overload. (RELATED: Store Allegedly Let Food Stamps Users Buy MILLIONS In Bongs, Pipes)

“To prevent sensory overload, autistic shutdowns, or meltdowns, he requires specific sensory regulating safe foods, including specific branded and flavored sodas and candies,” the lawsuit reads. “He also relies on chewing gum and mints to ground himself during PTSD-related flashbacks and panic responses.”

Another plaintiff with autism and ADHD requires access to these restricted foods because “cooking is very difficult and she is not always able to process when she is hungry.”

NEW YORK, NEW YORK - OCTOBER 30: An EBT sign is displayed on the window of a grocery store on October 30, 2025 in the Flatbush neighborhood of the Brooklyn borough in New York City. Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits and other assistance are set to stop on November 1st amid a federal government shutdown that has been going on for 29 days and is the second-longest shutdown in the nation’s history. New York Gov. Kathy Hochul declared a state of emergency for extra emergency funds and personnel to be deployed, as SNAP payments will be suspended. About 42 million Americans are expected to lose access to their benefits. (Photo by Michael M. Santiago/Getty Images)

One plaintiff suffering from multiple disabilities, including Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome, Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, and diabetes, requires “quick-sugar sources like candy to manage blood sugar drops.” (RELATED: Florida Becomes First State To Ban Tattoos, Vapes For Welfare Program)

“She often experiences nausea when she eats and relies on diet soda because the carbonation helps manage her nausea,” the lawsuit reads. “She takes medications throughout the day that must be taken with food, so she relies on quick, easy foods to eat multiple times a day.”

“The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program is just that — supplemental and crafted to offer nutrition assistance,” a USDA spokesperson told the Caller. “Yet again, the left found vulnerable recipients and convenient stores to use as pawns against the Make America Healthy Again agenda.”

“Interestingly, convenient stores also spent quite a bit of time and money avoiding improvements to their stocking standards, something the 2014 bipartisan farm bill authorized, and the Trump Administration finalized. Instead, they prefer to market jelly as a fruit and a meat stick as supper,” the spokesperson added. “The Department looks forward to vigorously and swiftly defending its approval of these 18 State restriction waivers.”
news.content:
(عکس از اندرو هارنیک/گتی ایماژ)
چندین دریافت کننده خدمات رفاهی اوتیستیک، دیابتی و معلول از وزارت کشاورزی رئیس جمهور دونالد ترامپ (USDA) برای بازگرداندن دسترسی به کوپن های غذایی به غذاهای ناسالم شکایت می کنند. تعدادی از شاکیانی که به برنامه کمک تغذیه تکمیلی (SNAP) متکی هستند، پس از اینکه بروک رولینز، وزیر کشاورزی، دسترسی برنامه را به غذاهای ناخواسته مانند نوشابه و آب نبات محدود کرد، از دولت در کنار فروشگاه‌های رفاه شکایت کردند. در شکایت ادعا شده است که این محدودیت‌ها «خودسرانه و غیرعادی و غیرعادی» بوده است. 2008. شاکیان همچنین استدلال کردند که شرایط بهداشتی مانند اوتیسم و ​​دیابت آنها را به غذاهای ناخواسته راحت و قابل نگهداری متکی می کند. در این شکایت از یک شاکی اوتیسم نام برده شده است که برای جلوگیری از ذوب شدن و اضافه بار حسی نیاز به دسترسی به "غذاهای ایمن تنظیم کننده حسی" از طریق برنامه SNAP دارد. (مرتبط: ظاهراً فروشگاه به کاربران کوپن های غذا اجازه می دهد میلیون ها بونگ، لوله بخرند) در این دادخواست آمده است: "برای جلوگیری از اضافه بار حسی، خاموش شدن اوتیسم یا ذوب شدن، او به غذاهای ایمن تنظیم کننده حسی خاص، از جمله نوشابه ها و آب نبات های مارک دار و طعم دار خاص نیاز دارد." او همچنین به جویدن آدامس و نعناع تکیه می‌کند تا خود را در هنگام فلاش‌بک‌های مرتبط با PTSD و پاسخ‌های هراس زمین کند.» یکی دیگر از شاکیان مبتلا به اوتیسم و ​​ADHD نیاز به دسترسی به این غذاهای محدود شده دارد زیرا "آشپزی بسیار دشوار است و او همیشه نمی تواند وقتی گرسنه است آن را پردازش کند."
نیویورک، نیو

news.originalContent: The IDF addressed the strikes carried out overnight in southern Lebanon, including in the village of Kfar Reman, saying on Monday afternoon that they began after Hezbollah terrorists launched two explosive drones at Israeli forces on the Ali Taher ridge in southern Lebanon. No IDF troops were injured in the drone launches, and the military said it immediately began striking Hezbollah infrastructure in several areas across southern Lebanon, including what it said was a weapons storage facility.   No IDF troops were injured in the drone launches, and the military said it immediately began striking Hezbollah infrastructure in several areas across southern Lebanon, including what it said was a weapons storage facility. A vehicle in which two people were killed. The Associated Press reported that the vehicle belonged to the Lebanese Scout and Rescue Association, Al-Risala, and that one of those killed was a paramedic with the organization. Two other people were wounded. At the same time, Lebanese reports said a building in Kfar Reman where a large number of people were staying was also struck, killing nine people, including women and children, and wounding 11 others.   Prior to the strikes, steps were taken to mitigate harm to uninvolved individuals, including the use of precise munitions and aerial surveillance," the IDF said in response. "The claim that several uninvolved individuals were harmed as a result of the strikes is being reviewed.” The IDF said that, in addition, following the launch of the explosive drones Sunday, “the IDF struck in the Nabatieh area and eliminated several Hezbollah terrorists. "The IDF will not allow the Hezbollah terrorist organization to harm Israeli civilians or IDF soldiers and will continue to operate to remove threats while remaining committed to the ceasefire agreement." “We lived under constant intimidation because of the bombardments on the outskirts of the village,” Fouad Chakroun, a resident of Kfar Reman told AP as he stood in front of the destroyed building. “Now they have struck the heart of the village.” Another resident, Saleh Madlij, said families and children had been staying in the building. “Are there missiles here?” he said sarcastically. “I will not leave this place.” The BBC reported that, according to Lebanese media, seven additional people were killed in strikes Sunday, while Lebanese President Joseph Aoun warned that the attacks represented a “dangerous escalation” that threatened the ceasefire.
news.content: ارتش اسرائیل به حملاتی که شب گذشته در جنوب لبنان از جمله در روستای کفرمان انجام شد، پرداخت و گفت که این حملات بعد از ظهر دوشنبه پس از پرتاب دو پهپاد انفجاری توسط تروریست‌های حزب‌الله به سمت نیروهای اسرائیلی در خط الراس علی طاهر در جنوب لبنان آغاز شد. هیچ نیروی ارتش اسرائیل در پرتاب هواپیماهای بدون سرنشین آسیبی ندید و ارتش اعلام کرد که بلافاصله حمله به زیرساخت‌های حزب‌الله را در چندین منطقه در جنوب لبنان از جمله تأسیسات ذخیره‌سازی سلاح آغاز کرده است.   هیچ نیروی ارتش اسرائیل در پرتاب هواپیماهای بدون سرنشین آسیبی ندید و ارتش اعلام کرد که بلافاصله حمله به زیرساخت‌های حزب‌الله را در چندین منطقه در جنوب لبنان از جمله تأسیسات ذخیره‌سازی سلاح آغاز کرده است. خودرویی که در آن دو نفر کشته شدند. آسوشیتدپرس گزارش داد که این خودرو متعلق به انجمن پیشاهنگی و نجات لبنان، الرساله است و یکی از کشته شدگان، امدادگر این سازمان است. دو نفر دیگر زخمی شدند. همزمان، گزارش‌های لبنانی حاکی از آن است که ساختمانی در کفارمان که تعداد زیادی از مردم در آن اقامت داشتند نیز مورد اصابت قرار گرفت و 9 نفر از جمله زن و کودک کشته و 11 نفر زخمی شدند.   ارتش اسرائیل در پاسخ گفت: قبل از حملات، اقداماتی برای کاهش آسیب به افراد غیرمجاز از جمله استفاده از مهمات دقیق و نظارت هوایی انجام شد. این ادعا که در نتیجه این اعتصابات به چندین فرد غیرمجاز آسیب وارد شده است، در حال بررسی است. ارتش اسرائیل گفت که علاوه بر این، دنبال کنید

news.originalContent: Senior government officials admit that Israel's public opinion in the international community "has never been worse." According to them, the situation only worsens, and the support the world has shown Israel following Hamas’s attack on October 7 has already been forgotten.  Follow Ynetnews on Facebook | Twitter | Instagram | TikTok >> More stories: IDF releases name of fallen soldier in West Bank terror attack UN chief in Rafah crossing says world 'seen enough' of Gaza war Two Air Force pilots reminisce about their murdered brothers: 'There's no room for pain in the air' The officials added that the intensity of accusations made against Israel only increases, and attempts to equate Hamas's actions in Israel are being made, with allegations accusing IDF soldiers of sexually harassing Palestinian prisoners. Ministers in the government blame Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for the complete neglect of Israel’s public relations: "There’s no leader present it’s been abandoned. A pandemic of sanctions against Israel may break out, and if we don't wake up, it will be too late. Something big needed to be done in terms of public relations, we need to rally the Jewish people and launch an international campaign. There’s no leader to head this. We’re losing. Our friends tell us: we support you, but you’re losing in the court of public opinion." A senior figure in Israel's advocacy efforts added, "They neutralized the Foreign Ministry and took away all its budget. The Foreign Ministry has no funding. To this day, no money was delivered. We’re working with a budget of 2 million shekels allocated for the war since the beginning of the year.  “Each U.S. consulate receives $5,000 a year for public relations efforts, including Independence Day events. For example, the consulate in Boston, which is also responsible for MIT, has to struggle to have such an amount. It’s ridiculous. When you already have a talented spokesman like Eylon Levy, they unjustly suspend him. He was one of the few people who did his mission in the most talented, beautiful, and correct way, and they sent him home,” the source said.   Internal reports from Israeli missions in the United States describe a very harsh picture of Israeli coverage in the American media. One report described, "The media awaited a sign from the government for a policy change, and when it arrived - it unleashed a rampage and published constant harsh criticism against Israel that had always existed. The harsh reports from Gaza, alongside internal tensions in the U.S., threaten to push moderate writers from the mainstream to adopt critical positions toward Israel and demand an immediate and permanent cease-fire.” 'the graphic images undermine the war’s legitimacy' “Pressure on the Biden administration to harden its stance toward Israel and condition military aid for an Israeli policy change constitutes a warning sign for the future,” the report added. “In terms of 'color,' we’re currently in a 'dark orange.' “There’s a change in stances even among staunch supporters of Israel – and while the conservative media fully supported Israel's actions in the past, this time voices questioning the proportionality of Israeli action have also been heard. However, no demand for a cease-fire is expected to appear in those media outlets. Without a fundamental change in the humanitarian issue in Gaza and/or signs on the diplomatic solution on the horizon, criticism of Israel in the media is expected to intensify,” the report read. It was added, "In the last month, the U.S. media’s spotlight turned to the worsening humanitarian crisis in Gaza, with special emphasis given to the suffering of Rafah residents against the backdrop of the possibility of the IDF expanding the ground operation there as well. Leading media outlets flooded screens and front pages with images of starving children, trauma victims, and the destruction of homes and hospitals. Reports and personal stories from Rafah led to empathy toward the Palestinians’ suffering and anger toward Israel's military actions. "Although most media outlets refrained from blaming Israel for creating the crisis intentionally or denying its right to self-defense, opinion pieces sparked fierce debate regarding the proportionality and morality of the ongoing military operation in its current form. Critical voices that were once silenced now have a wider platform.    “Reports focused on the immense humanitarian damages and the harm to innocent civilians, which many analysts argue is unjustified and goes against the values of the IDF’s operation. Even publicists who supported Israel in the past admitted that the graphic images undermine the war’s legitimacy,” the report read. “Against this backdrop, a narrative is emerging among liberal authors, which sees the Biden administration and its policy of providing weapons and diplomatic support to Israel as responsible for the situation, or at least as someone who can bring it to an end." Furthermore, dozens of recent opinion pieces represent a wide range of positions regarding the IDF’s legitimacy, the humanitarian crisis in Gaza, the question of a cease-fire, and the future of U.S.-Israel relations: Conservative media outlets like The Wall Street Journal and The New York Post fully support Israel, advocate for continued military action against Hamas, and refrain from calling for an immediate and prolonged stop to the war.  In contrast, newspapers identified with the center and liberal left, including The New York Times and The Washington Post, criticize the war’s escalation, citing the destructive consequences of the confrontation on Palestinian civilians, and therefore calling for an immediate humanitarian cease-fire, the reports explained.   The reports also expose an erosion of Israel's standing in Washington against the backdrop of the escalation in the Gaza war. This was clearly reflected in U.S. President Joe Biden's statement regarding a "red line" on military operations in Rafah, and Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer's speech.  Most analysts don’t foresee an immediate shift in relations between the countries, but caution against potential political damage to both sides. Furthermore, calls are increasing to use American military aid to Israel as leverage to force policy change in Jerusalem. However, warnings have been raised that the fact of having this discussion could bolster Hamas's position and undermine the chances of a cease-fire.  While conservative media outlets present Israel's policy as legitimate self-defense, liberal media outlets provide a platform for writers who echo the Palestinian narrative, sometimes using rhetoric accusing Israel of "apartheid" and even "genocide." Calls for the U.S. government to distance itself from supporting Israel and reconsider its military aid plan are becoming more common, even in moderate media outlets. The report mentions articles in The Washington Post and The Daily Beast highlighting the effectiveness of pro-Palestinian activists in influencing public opinion in the U.S., especially among progressive Democratic voters. The articles point to growing discontent with the Biden administration's support for Israel, reflected in "Uncommitted" votes in the Democratic primaries and disruptions at party events. Tactics such as demanding a cease-fire and using the term "genocide" have succeeded in keeping the war at the forefront of the national political agenda and increasing pressure on Washington to minimize its support of Israel.  The increasing willingness of Democratic politicians to criticize Israel suggests a shift in the party's traditional stance and leads to speech free of restraint in media outlets as well. This trend reached its zenith with Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer's speech, in which he labeled Netanyahu an "obstacle to peace" and accused him of damaging Israel's international standing, calling for early Israeli elections.

news.originalContent: Rather than celebrating and resting over the three-day holiday, residents of the Jewish community of Hendon in north London and Radlett were struck by shock and grief after the deadly terror attack that took the lives of two daughters of their beloved and esteemed Rabbi Leo Dee, on Friday, the second day of Passover which is considered a holly day in diaspora communities.   Follow Ynetnews on Facebook and Twitter >> Related stories: Israel names two sisters killed in West Bank terror attack At least one dead and six injured in a terror attack in Tel Aviv Family loses two daughters to deadly terror attack Members of the Jewish London community, including friends of the family, who heard of the devastating news after the Shabbat ended, were confronted only then, with the horrific reports of Maia and Rina's death. The funerals for the Dee sisters will be held today at the Kfar Etzion Cemetery.   Rabbi Leo Dee served as the Assistant Rabbi at the Hendon United Synagogue in North London from 2008-2011, and as the Senior Rabbi at Radlett United Synagogue from 2011-2014, after which the family made aliyah. They were a much beloved and respected family in the UK Jewish community. “People feel shock and disappointment. The family were communal people and served their communities well and were well-liked.” said a former member of the congregation at Hendon United Synagogue who did not wish to be named.  “I feel sick seeing this… good people who would never hurt anyone, murdered. I can't imagine his anguish, and pray Lucy survives,” said Joseph, another former congregant.   Chief UK Rabbi Sir Ephraim Mirvis laments the death of the British-Israeli girls murdered in Friday's terror strike on the West Bank.  In a statement, the rabbi said: "No words can describe the depth of our shock and sadness at the heartbreaking news of the murder by terrorists in Israel of Maya & Rina Dee, daughters of Rebbetzen Lucy, who is in a critical condition & Rabbi Leo Dee, my dear colleagues. He continued, “They were much loved in the Hendon and Radlett communities in the UK, as well as in Israel and well beyond.” UK statement not mentioning terrorism The British Board of Deputies also issued a statement expressing shock over the tragic attack: “We are deeply shocked and saddened at the murder by Palestinian terrorists of Maia and Rina Dee, the daughters of Rabbi Leo and Lucy Dee formerly of Radlett United Synagogue. We wish Lucy Refuah Shlemah and long life to the family as they cope with this devastating news.” Palestinian terrorist shot and killed 2 British-Israeli nationals, also critically injuring their mother in the West Bank. The victims were identified Saturday as 15-year-old Rina Dee and 20-year-old Maia Dee, the daughters of British-born Rabbi Leo Dee.  While their mother, Lucy (Lea), remains in critical condition fighting for her life, the Jewish community in the UK has expressed shock and sorrow at the brutal act of terrorism against former members of their community.    While many Jewish community leaders spoke out about the attack, the UK government has received criticism from some members of the community for its weakly-worded response to the killing of two of its own citizens.  One member of the Jewish community told Ynet that it was shocking that the UK statement didn’t even mention terrorism. “The response would be different if this happened elsewhere in the world. There is a double standard for British people killed in Israel,” he said.  The UK’s official statement read: “We are saddened to hear about the deaths of two British-Israeli citizens and the serious injuries sustained by a third individual. The UK calls for all parties across the region to de-escalate tensions.” "Tragedy for global Jewish community" Avi Abelow, family friend, said Rabbi Leo and Lucy Dee are beloved and active members of their community in Efrat. "Two of the sweetest people with the sweetest children", he added. "Rabbi Leo continues to teach Torah classes in his Efrat synagogue today. All the youth of Efrat, as their families, are mourning the loss of either their personal friend or the sibling of their personal friend."  He mentioned that "Just last night the whole community got together, including many youth, for a special communal prayer gathering to pray for Lucy's recovery. The brutal Arab Muslim terrorist attack that murdered these two young, innocent Jewish women, and seriously injured their mother fighting for her life, is not just a tragedy for their family, but for the whole Efrat community and the global Jewish community.  "At the same time that another terrorist committed a terror attack in Tel Aviv, which killed an Italian tourist, and terrorist organizations are shooting rockets at Israel from Lebanon, Syria and Gaza, we are once again reminded that the Jewish people have enemies trying to kill us everywhere in our country for just being Jews living in our ancestral homeland.  "If only the UK government and other global bodies would recognize this truth, and truly give support to Israel to stop this ongoing terror war against Israel, which causes loss of life for everyone. In the meantime, as a personal friend and neighbor of the Dee family, my family, neighbors, and community will continue to assist and comfort the Dee family, as we assisted and comforted the family of our other friend and neighbor, Ari Fuld, murdered by terrorists back in 2018."

news.originalContent: Iran's powerful Revolutionary Guards warned anti-government protesters of "decisive" action if unrest over gasoline price hikes do not cease, state television reported on Monday. The warning appeared to hint at a looming crackdown on protests that flared nationwide in response to an official announcement on Friday of gasoline rationing and price hikes of at least 50 percent. "If necessary we will take decisive and revolutionary action against any continued moves to disturb the people's peace and security," the Guards said in a statement carried by state media.
news.content: تلویزیون دولتی روز دوشنبه گزارش داد که سپاه پاسداران قدرتمند ایران به معترضان ضد دولتی هشدار داد که اگر ناآرامی ها بر سر افزایش قیمت بنزین متوقف نشود، اقدام «قاطعانه» خواهند کرد. به نظر می‌رسد این هشدار به سرکوب اعتراض‌هایی که در سراسر کشور در واکنش به اعلام رسمی روز جمعه مبنی بر سهمیه‌بندی بنزین و افزایش حداقل 50 درصدی قیمت‌ها شعله‌ور شد، اشاره می‌کند. سپاه پاسداران در بیانیه‌ای که توسط رسانه‌های دولتی منتشر شد، گفت: «در صورت لزوم، در برابر هرگونه اقدام مستمر برای برهم زدن آرامش و امنیت مردم، اقدام قاطع و انقلابی خواهیم کرد».
